hooks.command: cd /home/vader/MY_SRC/saferefundagent && OUTPUT=$(make check 2>&1); STATUS=$?; TAIL=$(printf '%s' "$OUTPUT" | tail -c 4000); MSG=$(printf 'make check exit=%s\n%s' "$STATUS" "$TAIL"); jq -n --arg msg "$MSG" '{systemMessage: $msg}'

INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$FILE" in *tests/invariants/*|*docs/ARCHITECTURE.md|*docs/CLAIMS.md|*DEBT.md) cd /home/vader/MY_SRC/saferefundagent && OUT=$(uv run pytest tests/invariants -q 2>&1); ST=$?; TAIL=$(printf '%s' "$OUT" | tail -c 3000); MSG=$(printf 'invariants check exit=%s for %s\n%s' "$ST" "$FILE" "$TAIL"); jq -n --arg msg "$MSG" '{systemMessage: $msg}' ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
